english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to say that someone sleeps.
Use this specifically when “rest” means to sleep.

examples.english: I need to go to sleep now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 heoi3 fan3 gaau3 laa3

examples.english: I have to get up early tomorrow, so I'm going to rest now.
examples.traditional: 聽日要早起，我而家去瞓覺喇。
examples.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 hei2 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 fan3 gaau3 laa3
